levels.100: Foundations: what happens when you press Queue
levels.200: Mechanics: how the pieces really work
levels.300: Architecture: the machinery inside the models
levels.400: Engineering and research: build, train, measure, scale

latent.name: Professor Latent
latent.bio: a calm, slightly cosmic professor who lives inside the compressed world the VAE builds.
latent.voice: Patient, uses vivid spatial metaphors, loves a good diagram described in words.

denoise.name: Dr. Denoise
denoise.bio: a lab-coated scientist who has watched ten thousand images emerge from static.
denoise.voice: Dry humour, precise, always asks 'what is the noise level at this step?'

attn.name: Madame Attention
attn.bio: a razor-sharp lecturer who decides what every token looks at.
attn.voice: Direct, elegant, a little theatrical; everything is about who attends to whom.

bits.name: Bit Bandit
bits.bio: a mischievous numerics goblin who hides in the last few bits of every float.
bits.voice: Playful, loves a counter-example, shows exactly where rounding bites.

graph.name: Captain Graph
graph.bio: a ship's captain who navigates node graphs and knows every wire.
graph.voice: Practical, step-by-step, nautical turns of phrase in moderation.

tune.name: Tinker Tune
tune.bio: a workshop tinkerer who trains, merges and measures models.
tune.voice: Hands-on, honest about what failed, always reports the measurement.

sound.name: DJ Spectrogram
sound.bio: a producer who sees sound as pictures.
sound.voice: Rhythmic, upbeat, explains with beats and frequencies.

frame.name: Reel Rascal
frame.bio: a film-reel sprite who counts frames and fights flicker.
frame.voice: Cinematic, energetic, thinks in shots and seconds.

courses.title: What generative AI actually is
courses.hook: Learn a distribution, then sample from it. Three models on one dataset show the difference between learning and memorising.

courses.title: Anatomy of a ComfyUI graph
courses.hook: Nodes, typed wires, execution order and caching.

courses.title: Pixels, tensors and shapes
courses.hook: Why [B,H,W,C] and [B,C,H,W] both exist and what breaks when you mix them.

courses.title: Prompts become numbers: tokens and embeddings
courses.hook: Tokenization, embedding tables and what a text encoder hands the model.

courses.title: Seeds, noise and determinism
courses.hook: Why the same seed gives the same picture and what changes it.

courses.title: Your first image: checkpoint, sampler, VAE
courses.hook: Follow one prompt through the whole text-to-image pipeline.

courses.title: Models on disk: safetensors and families
courses.hook: What is inside a model file and why families matter.

courses.title: Resolution, aspect ratio and the pixel budget
courses.hook: Master the art of balancing image dimensions to maximize detail without blowing up your VRAM usage.

courses.title: Reading a workflow JSON like a map
courses.hook: Stop staring at the spaghetti code and start seeing the logical flow of your image generation pipeline.

courses.title: Files and formats: PNG metadata, MP4, WAV, safetensors
courses.hook: Discover how ComfyUI reads and writes the invisible data that makes your images and models work.

courses.title: Latent space and the VAE
courses.hook: Train a tiny VAE on a CPU, and see why the midpoint of two latents is a picture while the midpoint of two images is a ghost.

courses.title: Diffusion from first principles
courses.hook: Destroy data with noise on purpose, learn to undo one step, and train a real model on a CPU.

courses.title: Score matching, Tweedie and the SDE view
courses.hook: Why predicting noise is the same as learning the gradient of the data density, proved numerically.

courses.title: Flow matching and rectified flow
courses.hook: Each training pair flies straight. The field you actually integrate does not, and that is the whole subject.

courses.title: Samplers are ODE solvers
courses.hook: Euler, Heun and DPM++ 2M written in five lines each, then measured against the exact answer.

courses.title: Sigma schedules: where the steps go
courses.hook: The scheduler chooses which noise levels the solver visits. Same model, same steps, different error.

courses.title: Ancestral and SDE samplers: adding noise back
courses.hook: Why a sampler that keeps injecting noise never settles on one image, and when that helps.

courses.title: Guidance: CFG and what it really does
courses.hook: One line of arithmetic, and it does not sample the distribution people usually say it does.

courses.title: Negative prompts and cfg 1.0
courses.hook: A negative prompt is not a subtraction of concepts. It replaces the unconditional branch, and at cfg 1 it does nothing at all.

courses.title: Precision: fp32, fp16, bf16, fp8
courses.hook: Where rounding bites: small LoRA deltas vanish, sums stall, and fp16 overflows at 65,504.

courses.title: Quantization: int8, FP8, 4-bit and GGUF
courses.hook: Trading bits for memory, and measuring what you lose.

courses.title: LoRA: low-rank adaptation
courses.hook: Why two skinny matrices can change a giant one.

courses.title: Inpainting masks and edge blending
courses.hook: Master the art of seamless image editing by learning how to mathematically feather mask edges for natural transitions.

courses.title: Conditioning: img2img, inpaint, ControlNet, IP-Adapter
courses.hook: Every way of telling the model more than a prompt.

courses.title: Video basics: frames, fps and temporal latents
courses.hook: Time as another axis, and why video models compress it.

courses.title: Audio and music basics: waveforms to spectrograms
courses.hook: Sample rate, Nyquist, STFT and why audio models work on spectrograms or latents.

courses.title: Upscaling and tiling math
courses.hook: Master the geometry of high-resolution generation by calculating exact tile overlaps and upscaling factors without relying on GPU acceleration.

courses.title: Seeds, batches and variations in video
courses.hook: Discover how a single integer seed transforms random noise into reproducible video variations across your entire batch.

courses.title: Depth and edge preprocessors: Sobel by hand
courses.hook: Stop treating depth maps as black boxes and learn to manually extract sharp edges using classic Sobel operators in pure PyTorch.

courses.title: The execution model: what runs, and in what order
courses.hook: ComfyUI starts from the output nodes and works backwards. Build its scheduler in 60 lines and watch a lazy input change the order.

courses.title: Caching: why changing the seed does not reload the model
courses.hook: Each node gets a key built from its whole ancestry. Change one input and only what lies downstream runs again.

courses.title: Sub-graphs and node expansion
courses.hook: A sub-graph is a front-end idea that the server never sees. Node expansion is a server idea that the front-end never sees.

courses.title: App Mode: a graph with a form on top
courses.hook: App Mode shows chosen inputs and outputs of a workflow as a simple form. The graph underneath does not change.

courses.title: The API: queue, watch, fetch
courses.hook: Everything the page does, a script can do: POST a prompt, read events from a websocket, fetch the files.

courses.title: Color spaces, gamma and image math
courses.hook: sRGB vs linear light and why blending in the wrong space looks muddy.

courses.title: History 1: GANs, the adversarial game (2014)
courses.hook: Discover how the adversarial game between generator and discriminator laid the foundation for modern generative AI.

courses.title: History 2: Variational autoencoders and the latent idea (2013)
courses.hook: Discover how the 'latent space' concept revolutionized generative AI by teaching machines to compress data into meaningful, continuous representations.

courses.title: History 3: Pixel by pixel, autoregressive image models
courses.hook: Discover how early AI painted images one pixel at a time, laying the groundwork for modern generative techniques.

courses.title: History 5: CLIP and contrastive learning
courses.hook: Discover how CLIP learns to match images and text by maximizing the similarity of correct pairs while pushing incorrect ones apart.

courses.title: History 6: Denoising diffusion arrives (DDPM, 2020)
courses.hook: Discover how DDPM revolutionized image generation by teaching models to reverse noise step-by-step.

courses.title: History 7: Latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion (2022)
courses.hook: Discover how Stable Diffusion revolutionized image generation by operating in a compressed latent space rather than raw pixels.

courses.title: History 8: Adapters era: LoRA and ControlNet
courses.hook: Discover how low-rank adaptations and spatial controls revolutionized efficient fine-tuning in the ComfyUI ecosystem.

courses.title: Attention from scratch
courses.hook: Scaled dot-product attention in six lines, why the square root of d is there, and how a prompt reaches a pixel.

courses.title: Multi-head, GQA and RoPE
courses.hook: Splitting attention, sharing keys, and rotating positions.

courses.title: DiT and MM-DiT blocks
courses.hook: How a transformer replaces the U-Net: patches, adaLN, joint text-image attention.

courses.title: Why attention is O(n^2) and how Flash/Sage fix the memory
courses.hook: Tiling, online softmax and the memory wall.

courses.title: VRAM budget math: weights, activations, caches
courses.hook: Predicting whether it fits before you press Queue.

courses.title: Text encoders: CLIP, T5 and LLM encoders
courses.hook: What each encoder gives the model and what it costs.

courses.title: 3D generation: meshes, SDFs, voxels and Gaussian splats
courses.hook: The shapes a model can output and how they convert.

courses.title: Speed: distillation, caching, compile, fewer steps
courses.hook: Where the seconds go and how to get them back.

courses.title: Positional encodings in 2D and 3D
courses.hook: Discover how we inject spatial awareness into neural networks by transforming grid coordinates into rich frequency signals.

courses.title: Cross-attention versus joint attention
courses.hook: Discover how ComfyUI's attention mechanisms differ by exploring the mathematical distinction between conditioning on external prompts and self-attending within

courses.title: Mixed precision: where accumulation hides
courses.hook: Discover why your gradients vanish or explode when mixing float16 and float32, and how ComfyUI's scheduler hides the accumulation trap.

courses.title: KV cache and autoregressive decoding
courses.hook: Discover how ComfyUI's text encoders and diffusion schedulers leverage caching to speed up sequential generation without sacrificing quality.

courses.title: Mixture of experts routing
courses.hook: Discover how ComfyUI's advanced diffusion models intelligently select the right expert for each token to boost efficiency and quality.

courses.title: Flow-matching losses and velocity targets
courses.hook: Learn how to compute the exact velocity field that guides your diffusion model from noise to data.

courses.title: Temporal consistency and optical flow basics
courses.hook: Learn how to keep your AI videos from jittering by mastering the math behind motion estimation.

courses.title: Video VAEs and receptive fields
courses.hook: Discover how Video VAEs compress temporal dimensions and why understanding receptive fields is key to controlling motion artifacts.

courses.title: Sparse and windowed attention
courses.hook: Discover how limiting attention to local windows and sparse patterns drastically reduces computational cost while preserving spatial context.

courses.title: History 4: StyleGAN and style modulation
courses.hook: Discover how StyleGAN decouples content from style to achieve fine-grained control over generated images.

courses.title: History 9: Transformers replace U-Nets: DiT and rectified flow
courses.hook: Discover how Diffusion Transformers (DiT) and rectified flow are reshaping the landscape of generative AI by moving away from traditional U-Net architectures.

courses.title: History 10: From frames to space-time: the road to modern video models
courses.hook: Discover how video generation evolved from static image sequences to coherent space-time volumes.

courses.title: History 11: Audio models: WaveNet to autoregressive music to diffusion music
courses.hook: Trace the evolution of AI audio from sample-by-sample prediction to holistic diffusion synthesis.

courses.title: History 13: Seeing in 3D: NeRF, Gaussian splats and structured latents
courses.hook: Explore how modern 3D generation moves from implicit fields to explicit particles and structured latent spaces to render photorealistic scenes.

courses.title: History 14: The speed era: LCM, turbo and distillation
courses.hook: Discover how we tricked diffusion models into thinking they were already finished, slashing generation time from minutes to seconds.

courses.title: History 15: The size era: FP8, GGUF and 4-bit formats arrive
courses.hook: Discover how quantization formats like FP8 and GGUF revolutionized local AI by shrinking model sizes without sacrificing too much quality.

courses.title: Writing a custom node with the V3 API
courses.hook: A class with a schema and an execute method. The engine calls your node without making an instance, and that changes how you write it.

courses.title: Memory management: who gets the GPU
courses.hook: Before each sampler run, ComfyUI budgets VRAM and evicts what it must. Replay the arithmetic and read your own logs.

courses.title: Model merging: weighted, SLERP, task arithmetic
courses.hook: Why averaging weights can work and when it fails.

courses.title: Evaluating outputs: metrics, checks and their limits
courses.hook: What PSNR, SSIM-style and embedding scores tell you, and what they cannot.

courses.title: Agents on ComfyUI: tools, verification, side-effect safety
courses.hook: Letting a model drive the graph without letting it break things.

courses.title: Scaling: sharding, batching and serving
courses.hook: From one GPU to many, and what throughput really means.

courses.title: Reading a generative-AI paper in 20 minutes
courses.hook: A method for extracting claims, assumptions and what to check.

courses.title: Distillation math: teacher, student, consistency
courses.hook: Learn how to compress a complex diffusion model into a fast, few-step generator by mastering the mathematical bridge between teacher guidance and student consis

courses.title: Quantization error propagation through layers
courses.hook: Discover how tiny rounding errors in low-bit weights can snowball into significant output drift as they pass through deep neural networks.

courses.title: Evaluating video: a flicker metric
courses.hook: Learn to quantify visual stability by calculating the temporal variance of pixel intensities to detect flicker in generated video sequences.

courses.title: Dataset curation and captioning for training
courses.hook: Learn how to transform raw images into high-quality training data by mastering precise captioning and dataset balancing techniques.

courses.title: Prompt adherence evaluation
courses.hook: Learn to quantify how well your generated images actually match the text prompts using deterministic CPU-based metrics.

courses.title: Reproducibility and provenance: hashing graphs and seeds
courses.hook: Learn how to cryptographically fingerprint your ComfyUI workflows and seeds to ensure bit-perfect reproducibility across different machines and sessions.

courses.title: Profiling memory and time on a GPU (with a CPU model of it)
courses.hook: Learn to predict GPU memory bottlenecks by simulating tensor lifecycles and operation costs on your CPU.

courses.title: History 16: What open means: weights, licences and the ecosystem
courses.hook: Explore the legal and technical boundaries of open-source AI by dissecting how model weights, licenses, and community contributions shape the ComfyUI ecosystem.

courses.title: History 17: Studios and agents: when models became pipelines
courses.hook: Discover how ComfyUI transforms static model calls into dynamic, agent-driven pipelines that orchestrate complex creative workflows.
